## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/validate.sh` passes
- [ ] `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] The description says what it does **and** when to use it, with real trigger phrases
- [ ] No private info: company names, internal URLs, IDs, phone numbers, keys, customer data
- [ ] New skill added to the table in `README.md`
- [ ] It's my own work, or the source's license allows it and it's credited
